app.name: SineX
app.description: SineX is a cross-platform desktop app to stream and download any Movie, TV Series or Anime in the World. Zero Ads and Tracking.
app.inspiredBy: Inspired by Streambert. Built with Electron, React, and Vite.
home.noInternetDesc: Trending and search require an internet connection. Your downloads and library still work offline.

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.generalDesc: App version, updates, API credentials and language
settings.contentDesc: Parental controls and content filtering by age rating
settings.subtitlesDesc: Subtitle download sources and API keys
settings.downloadsDesc: Where downloaded video files are saved on disk
settings.notificationsDesc: Desktop alerts for downloads and new episode releases
settings.interfaceDesc: Home layout, start page, appearance, and display options
settings.libraryDesc: Watchlist sort order and watch history preferences
settings.backupDesc: Export your data or restore from a previous backup file
settings.storageDesc: Clear cache, watch progress, downloads, or reset the entire app
settings.noUpdateUrl: No update URL configured. Set one above to enable update checks.
settings.updateUrlHelp: Leave empty to disable. The server must return a JSON with latest (version string), url (download), and optional changelog.
settings.autoCheckDesc: Shows a notification banner if a new version is available.
settings.tmdbTokenDesc: Used to fetch movie and TV metadata, posters, ratings, and cast info from The Movie Database.
settings.languageDesc: Controls both the display language for metadata and the default language for subtitle downloads.
settings.ageRatingDesc: Set a maximum age rating. Content rated above this age will still be visible but you won't be able to play it. Set to No restriction to disable this feature entirely.
settings.invidiousDesc: Trailers are played via Invidious, a privacy-friendly YouTube frontend. Your configured instance is tried first; if it fails, the app automatically falls back through a list of known working instances.
settings.invidiousUnreachable: Could not reach instance. Check the URL or try another.
settings.autoWatchedDesc: A movie or episode is automatically marked as Watched ✓ when the remaining time drops to this value or below. Set between 1 and 300 seconds.
settings.introSkipDesc: Uses AniSkip to detect and skip opening/ending segments. Only active for animes and when using AllManga as source.
settings.introSkipAutoDesc: Automatically jumps past the intro/outro when reached.
settings.introSkipManualDesc: Shows a "Skip Intro" button at the bottom of the player.
settings.subtitleSourceInfo: is used by default and requires a free API key (no account needed). Optionally add a SubDL API key (free), to use SubDL as the primary source instead.
settings.subdlPlaceholder: SubDL API key, leave empty to use Wyzie
settings.subdlHelp: Leave empty to use Wyzie Subs (default, requires Wyzie API key above). Add a SubDL key to switch to SubDL as the primary source.
settings.wyzieRequired: Required for Wyzie Subs. Claim a free key, no account needed.
settings.wyzieErrorTimeout: No key received within 10 seconds. Try again or enter it manually.
settings.wyzieErrorExtract: Could not extract key automatically. Try entering it manually.
settings.notificationsDesc2: Control which events trigger a desktop notification.
settings.notifyDownloadCompleteDesc: Shows a desktop notification when an item finishes downloading.
settings.notifyNewEpisodes: Notify about new episodes on startup
settings.notifyNewEpisodesDesc: On startup, checks every TV series you have saved for newly released episodes and notifies you if any aired since the last check.
settings.homeLayoutDesc: Choose which rows appear on the Home page and drag to reorder them. The hero banner is always shown at the top.
settings.startPageDesc: Choose which page opens when you launch SineX.
settings.accentColorDesc: {{label}}, applied to buttons, highlights, and indicators.
settings.compactGridDesc: Shows more titles per row by reducing card size.
settings.reduceAnimationsDesc: Disables transitions and hover effects throughout the app.
settings.watchlistSortDesc: How titles in your watchlist are sorted. "Custom order" keeps your drag-and-drop arrangement.
settings.recordHistoryDesc: When off, nothing you watch will be added to history or "Continue Watching".
settings.historyDisabled: ⚠ Watch history is disabled. Progress tracking and "Continue Watching" will not work.
settings.scheduledBackupsDesc: Automatically save a backup file on a schedule
settings.backupRestoreDesc: Export your watchlist, watch history, progress, and all settings to a JSON file. Import it later to restore everything, useful before reinstalling or switching devices.
settings.downloadFolderDesc: Downloaded videos will be saved here. Make sure the folder exists and SineX has write access to it.
settings.noFolderWarning: ⚠ No download folder set - videos cannot be downloaded until you set one.
settings.installLocationDesc: Opens the folder where SineX is installed.
settings.clearCacheDesc: Removes temporary browser cache, shader cache, and service worker data from all internal sessions (main, video player, trailer). Does not affect your personal data or settings.
settings.clearProgressDesc: Resets all watch history, continue-watching progress, and watched / completed markings for movies and series. Also clears internal video player session data.
settings.deleteDownloadsDesc: Permanently deletes all video files that were downloaded through SineX and removes them from the download list. Only files downloaded through the app will be deleted, nothing else in your folder is touched.
settings.resetAppDesc: Completely resets SineX to factory defaults, clears all settings, API Token, saved library, watch history/progress, and all cached data. Your downloaded video files will not be touched.
settings.resetConfirmDesc: This will permanently erase all settings, API tokens, library data, watch history, and cached data. Your downloaded video files will not be touched.
settings.clearProgressConfirm: This will permanently delete all watch history, continue-watching progress, and watched/completed markings for all movies and series.
settings.deleteDownloadsConfirm: This will permanently delete all video files downloaded through SineX and remove them from the download list.
settings.aboutStreaming: Streaming: Watch any Movie, Anime or TV Series from around the World directly in the app.
settings.aboutDownloading: Downloading: Download anything you want to watch offline, with multithreading support.
settings.aboutSubtitles: Subtitles: Download and manage Subtitles from multiple providers.
settings.aboutCustomizability: Customizability: Customize the Interface and Features with themes, accent colours, font sizes, and layout options.
settings.aboutLibrary: Library: Track what you watched, save titles to your watchlist, and manage your Downloads.
settings.aboutPrivacy: Privacy: Completely Ad and Tracker free, with built-in request blocking.

setup.title: SINEX
setup.subtitle: Enter your free TMDB Read Access Token to get started.
setup.description: Go to themoviedb.org → Settings → API and copy the API Read Access Token (the long JWT, not the shorter API Key below).
setup.placeholder: Paste your TMDB Read Access Token (eyJ...)...
setup.errorInvalidDesc: TMDB rejected the token (401 Unauthorized). Make sure you copied the long JWT Read Access Token, not the shorter API Key.
setup.errorForbiddenDesc: TMDB returned 403 Forbidden. Your account may be suspended or the token may have been revoked.
setup.errorTimeoutDesc: TMDB took too long to respond. Check your internet connection and try again.
setup.errorNetworkDesc: No connection to api.themoviedb.org. Check your internet connection.
setup.errorUnknownDesc: TMDB returned an unexpected error{{status}}. Try again in a moment.
app.tokenInvalid: ⚠ Your TMDB token is invalid, not set or has been revoked. Movies and shows won't load.
app.cannotReachTmdb: ⚠ Cannot reach TMDB, check your internet connection. Content may not load.
